title: India operationalises 100% Insurance FDI under Sabka Bima Act 2025
summary: DPIIT notified 100% FDI under automatic route for insurance companies under Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act 2025 effective Feb 5, mandating at least 1 resident Indian CEO/MD/Chair.
